# Ruby Gillis

[Queen’s Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy)

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P66](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0066), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby is a handsome young lady with a plump, showy figure and a brilliant complexion. She has large, bright-blue eyes and a long yellow braid.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Ruby Gillis is a cheerful and good-tempered individual who enjoys the pleasant things of life, though she is also inclined to be hysterical. Driven by a desire to have numerous suitors and a gay time before settling down, she talks constantly of young men and intends to study to be a teacher for only two years before getting married. She also harbors a mortal dread of fat green caterpillars.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. ## History

Ruby Gillis grew up with many big sisters who were courted and married, and she once charmed away her warts using a magic pebble. She attended school alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and later joined her at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). As their studies progressed and final examinations approached, Ruby visited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md) to anxiously discuss their exams and commencement plans. Following her time at Queen's, she was hired to teach at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P12](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P17](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0017), +2 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby is a schoolmate and long-time playmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their connection is defined by shared childhood experiences in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), including attending school together and participating in school events like Miss Stacy's [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert preparations.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), +14 more_

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) are longtime playmates and schoolmates within the same social group in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Together with their peers, they participate in school events and join creative group endeavors, such as the story club started by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jane-andrews--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) are friends and schoolmates who socialize together, such as spending a midsummer afternoon playing games. Their shared academic journey carries through their time at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), where they visit friends together to anxiously discuss their upcoming final examinations and commencement plans.
